data.narrative:
Renaissance Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Francesco Volpe and Martin Kupp that has raised $60.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Valar Atomics at Series B/$6.0B, Nano Nuclear Energy at Seed/$808M, and Fuse Energy at Series A/$200M), supplemented by reference to 8 additional private peers and 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR).

Two triangulation methods apply here. The stage-progression method, anchoring to $60M in total raised and applying a typical 2.0x Series A-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a valuation of $121M. The peer-median method, taking the median across the three same-sector peers, implies $808M, though the peer range spans $200M to $6.0B, reflecting substantial dispersion in the sector. The wide peer range reflects the nascent and heterogeneous nature of advanced nuclear financing.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $103M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $464M. The substantial gap between methods—stage-progression yielding $121M versus peer-median at $808M—reflects uncertainty about whether Renaissance Fusion's capital efficiency and technology trajectory justify a premium or discount to observed peer valuations. Key sensitivities include commercialization timeline, regulatory pathway clarity, and capital requirements to first deployment.
